lines.english: "We bring you the news for February 14th, Valentine's Day."
"Let's start with a report from Miley Sports… 'Touma Kazusa's Additional Concert to be Canceled?'"
"Following the positive reception of her first concert in Japan held in January, pianist Touma Kazusa had made plans to hold an additional concert near the end of this month."
"However, recent statements made by related sources have cast doubt on any future performance being held, due to poor health."
"Neither Kazusa-san, nor her producer and mother, Touma Youko-san, have made any appearances before the press since the previous concert…"
"Thus, it is likely that her health has indeed deteriorated since the previous concert, and that she is currently recuperating in a hospital somewhere within the Metropolitan Area."
"In fact, just last week, an ambulance was dispatched late at night to the hotel where Kazusa-san was thought to have been staying."
"Eyewitness reports on the scene expressed the possibility that the woman carried out at the time was Kazusa-san herself, adding further concerns to whether the additional concert will be held."
"Furthermore, a statement made by Touma Youko Office last night had this to say regarding the issue: 'We have received no such report and are currently investigating the matter.'"
"Tickets for Touma Kazusa-san's first concert in Japan sold out within an hour, putting the demand for her performances at an unprecedented level for a classical musician…"
"What's the meaning of this advertisement…? It was supposed to be 2100 yen, right? Why does it suddenly cost 3150 yen now?"
"Even if it is a special issue, the price for this is… Eh? You're saying that I strongly insisted it be so? What do you mean by that?"
"…Huh? I haven't heard anything about that at all! How did things end up like this?"
"Yeah, yeah… What did you just say? But that's… Wasn't that all already decided in the plan from the very beginning?"
"Did Yoshimatsu-san tell you about all that? No, like I said, it wasn't me…"
"…So that means…"
"…It seems that the both of us have been deceived by our subordinates. Yeah, yeah, I totally understand. At any rate, I'm going to discuss this with him in person now. Well, if you'll excuse me."
"Kitahara!"
"Kitahara! Where did you run off to, you bastard!"
"Oh, shut up already, jeez!"
"If you're looking for Kitahara, he went home immediately after the briefing earlier. He did show his face before you came to work, though."
"…Did he run away?"
"The special issue of Ensemble is already nearing its deadline anyway, so I'd say you can't expect things to not be busy on his end."
"Although he's at the bottom of the pyramid when it comes to work on Kaiou Graph, he has the widest scope of work capability among all of the members here, huh?"
"I guess they don't call him Kazaoka the Second for nothing…"
"This isn't the time for this nonsense. Things suddenly just got really awry with that special issue."
"What do you mean, really awry? Are you telling me we've suddenly got our hands on Touma Kazusa's nude gravure photos?"
"No, I imagine we'd get rewarded by the president for that…"
"Sure, I guess this can be considered a scoop in some ways… still, how did a plan like this even get approved? How did they suddenly decide on a collaboration out of the blue?"
"A collaboration? Things are suddenly really escalating now, huh?"
"Can we please not forget something? You know that he's still a rookie in his first year, right?"
"And while all this is happening, rumors about the additional concert being canceled are all over the place… I just don't get any of this. What in the world have you done, Kitahara!?"
"You have reached the voicemail for this number. Please leave your message within 30 seconds after the beep."
"Sorry for keeping you waiting. I've finally settled things on my end."
"Ah…"
"What's wrong? You still can't reach him?"
"I've only been receiving voicemail requests throughout the week. What in the world is going on with you, Haruki…?"
"Hasn't he been working overtime for the past couple of days due to his deadline approaching? If I recall correctly, he's responsible for that issue that's coming out next month, isn't he?"
"He'd still at least say something to us even if that were the case. And even then, today is… Does he have any intention of making it?"
"We can only trust that he will. There's no way Haruki would ever forget what day it is today."
"Still, don't you think those two have been acting strangely recently?"
"That's…"
"It seems that they're wary about meeting us, and Setsuna-chan didn't really give me anything to work with when I inquired about things on her end."
"Well, you know, she said 'we're both busy,' didn't she? So it's only the fact that they really can't help it at the moment, that's all…"
"…Could he have gotten himself involved in Touma's affairs again?"
"S-Stop saying stuff like that!"
"Well, come on… there's already news about her public performance being canceled, right? He's absolutely going to be bothered by that. Maybe he's even gone off to where Touma is right now…"
"Like I said, just stop! You're going to make me feel uneasy too at this rate!"
"Ah… well, regardless of all that, there's no way things can happen between Touma and Haruki the way they are now… Yeah! It's just not possible!"
"…And you can't even reassure yourself properly despite causing me to worry."
"At any rate, we have to make sure that everything's alright today. It's about time we headed over, right? I assume Setsuna-chan's already returned home as well?"
"Now that you mention it… actually, ever since this morning, she…"
"Well, I take it you were the one that let that report slip, Miyo-chan?"
"Whispers were spreading amongst the media that your health had been failing recently, so I thought that I'd mislead them with a false clue."
"…I see. Once it is made known Kazusa was fine all along, people will be less skeptical when my illness is reported on."
"It was you who taught me how to turn a crisis into an opportunity."
"I would expect no less of Touma Youko Office's best employee. Thanks!"
"I also happen to be the only employee in the Japanese branch."
"…So, is she still not ready?"
"Yes, she hasn't taken so much as even a step out of the guest room. …She has been keeping this up for a week by now, though."
"I see…"
"I do check on her three times a day, but she still refuses to open the door for me."
"I'm sorry, Miyo-chan. My daughter is causing you a lot of trouble."
"It's okay. I understand her feelings almost too well."
"…I highly doubt that."
"I'm so shocked I want to cry too. What would happen to Touma Youko Office if you retired…?"
"Well, let's worry about that when I leave the hospital. More importantly, how's preparation for the next concert going?"
"All preparations are already in order on that end, be it to commence it… or to revoke it. Part of the reason I spread that report was in order to do this."
"…You truly are Touma Youko Office's best employee!"
"The moment you made your decision, I started working on everything on all sides, minimizing the possible damage."
"Thank you, Miyo-chan. …But don't worry. The additional concert will commence on schedule."
"…Is it really possible? Truth be told, the way that Kazusa-san is right now, I can't see her returning to her usual playing quality within two weeks."
"The show must go on nevertheless. While I'm at it, I've assigned her with an errand before the concert. The person responsible for the affair will be heading your way tonight."
"Huh!? What are you saying, President!? Do you not understand the current situation at all?"
"Mother and daughter of the Touma family are now terminally ill and lovesick, respectively, and their lives as pianists are thus on the line… Did I get that right?"
"If you understand that, then please reconsider! What were you thinking, adding an extra burden onto her when we already have to be so careful about how to go about her next concert!"
"…Well, the truth is, I'm actually quite nervous myself. I did wonder if I ended up going too far this time."
"If you know that, then…!"
"Still… it's paramount that we actually use such a drastic measure this time. After all, it's not something that can be solved unless we're in Japan."
"But she's not willing to see anyone in her current state, you know? She doesn't even allow me to go in her room and check on her, so…"
"…I don't think we'll have any problems with that in this case. At any rate, Miyo-chan, when the person in charge arrives, you can simply lead them to her room."
"I won't be responsible for anything that happens thereafter, alright?"
"Yes, that's fine. …After all, the person arriving is someone who my little girl won't see herself running away from."
"…I don't really get what's going on, but I'll listen to you. That's my job, after all."
"I'm really sorry for troubling you all the time, you know? I'll give you a raise for your severance payment, then."
"Even if you're joking, please don't take it in such an ominous direction!"
"That will be all, then, Miyo-chan. I'll be leaving the rest to you～"
"Jeez!"
"…Lovesick?"
"Excuse me, please open the door!"
"There's a guest waiting for you in the lobby right now. The president has also given me directions to tell you that you have to meet with this person."
"Please, come out already! Even if only to eat something, at least!"
"Today… Today I won't back down so easily, okay? Until you give me a response, I'll be waiting right here, alright?"
"Are you alright? Are you awake? …Are you even properly conscious right now? I'm begging you, don't make us worry any more than you already have…"
"I'm sorry…"
"K-Kazusa-san? It's you, isn't it, Kazusa-san!?"
"I'm sorry, Miyoko-san… I'm really… sorry…!"
"Ah… thank goodness… in any case, that means you're okay, right? Are you hungry?"
"It's fine… I don't want to eat anything."
"Kazusa-san…"
"…I don't know anymore. I don't know anything anymore…"
"…For now, please open the door. Let's just calm down and have a little chat, alright?"
"I can't… I simply can't see anyone right now. I wouldn't even know what to say and what to do if I did."
"That's exactly why you need to get into contact with someone… You won't come up with a good solution all of a sudden just by brooding all by yourself in there, you know?"
"But, but… but… I just can't anymore… I don't want to stay in this country anymore… I want to go back to Vienna."
"But the president… what about your mother?"
"…I don't know, I just said I don't know anything anymore! It's because I don't know what to do anymore that I have to run away from here!"
"And yet, I can't even bring myself to run from this hopeless state I'm in. I've already finished packing a long time ago, but I can't even get out of here…"
"I can't do anything. I can't decide anything. I can't even move. There's no value in living on anymore…"
"But that's… but that's… ah…"
"Go home… for today. Don't worry, I'm still alive… and I'm still living my life shamefully…"
"Y-Yes, she is in this room, correct… but as I thought, she's still under the weather…"
"Yes, so I can't do anything more for today… eh? Ah, but that's…"
"Miyoko-san…?"
"Y-Yes, it's true that Touma told me that. …Is it okay if I put my faith in you?"
"Well… I'll hang up now."
"Ah, please wait a moment, Kazusa-san. I'm giving the phone over to someone else right now!"
"Giving it… but who?"
"Thank you for taking care of me all this time. I'm Ogiso… from Knights Records."
"It's been a long time… Kazusa."
"Ah…"
The snow stopped falling before the hour was even over, a far cry from my hope that it would last until morning.
There's still some time before the first train departs, and I feel tired enough to want to call a taxi.
I only remain alone in the cold, sitting on a bench in this vacant park, gazing at the sky as the clouds gradually drift away.
Yes… I couldn't even move.
"Good evening."
And yet Setsuna had rushed to where I was in a taxi as I stood helplessly in the middle of the night.
"Here, take this disposable heat pack. Put it in your pocket and you'll feel nice and warm… oh, what am I saying?"
Setsuna's hand sends a warmth across my entire body that's stronger than the heat of the heat pack she handed me.
"Good work today… Haruki-kun."
"Setsuna… Setsuna…"
As I thought, her voice, which I haven't so much as heard in two weeks, is still full of the undiminished tenderness it always held.
"I'm sorry for not contacting you all this time. I'm sorry for letting you suffer."
However, Setsuna has no need to apologize to me for the two weeks she'd spent being absent from my life.
"Sorry… I'm sorry, Setsuna… I really am incapable of supporting her."
"Mhm…"
I made a promise, after all.
That I wouldn't run away from Kazusa. That I'd stay by Kazusa's side from now on.
I'd promised to put Kazusa at ease.
And I'd promised that I wouldn't meet Setsuna again until I'd accomplished all of that.
"No, perhaps it was a mistake to even suggest that I would be able to support her in the first place… In the end, it was all pointless."
"It wasn't pointless. It's really nothing like that at all."
That's why Setsuna didn't reply to me no matter how many times I sent her texts filled with more excuses, just as we promised.
"I can't do it after all… I only cause her to suffer more by being with her. I'm turning into a bed of thorns for her…"
And yet it didn't even take five minutes before she called me back after I sent her a short "Help me."
She must've seen all those texts… even though she hadn't replied to any of them, Setsuna must've seen all of the texts I'd sent her.
"Can you… talk to me about it?"
And so she'd come here… Setsuna had come back to me.
"Tell me everything that's happened these two weeks. How much you've worked hard, Haruki-kun, and how much you've been held down as well…"
Setsuna accepted me when I, like Kazusa, ran away from the painful reality and sought salvation from her.
"Tell me… what you desire now, Haruki-kun."
"Setsuna… Setsuna…!"
Setsuna is looking at me with a compassionate gaze.
So I slowly reach out my hand, and stand up as if desiring her.
So I can cry in her chest.
"Let's do this again. …I'm Ogiso from the public relations department of Knights Records. I'll be under your care from here on."

"…Well, I suppose we've finally put proper pleasantries away for the time being. That aside, this really is an amazing room, isn't it～? How many tens of thousands of yen does this place charge per night?"
"I've stayed in a high-class hotel myself before, but I've only ever been given an average guest room… and I was still charged 20000 yen per night, you know?"
"Ah, I suppose this is just devolving into small talkーI'm sorry. My mother's very particular when it comes to costs and money like that, so I guess I've gradually taken after her as well."
"…Why…"
"Hmm?"
"Why have you come here? Did you come here to look down on me?"
"Kazusa…"
"Did you come here to laugh at me? To berate me? Or perhaps… are you saying you've come here because you pity me?"
"I came here… to talk. That's really all I'm here for."
"You're mad at me for what I did, aren't you? You have no intention of forgiving me, do you?"
"That's right… I'm still upset at you for how you've never tried to contact me even once despite having the rare opportunity to return here."
"…B-But you know full well that I couldn't possibly have done something like that…"
"Aa-ah, I really wanted to get in touch with you. Your old phone number doesn't work anymore, after all, and more importantly, you didn't even want to take the initiative to contact me at all."
"You're not even going to deny what I just said. Aa-ah, I'm actually a bit shocked…"
"So is this your way of getting your revenge? To see my miserable state for yourself… to mock my ugly self for retaining my feelings?"
"Why do you have to think about things so negatively…?"
"Because, because…! The one who told you where I'm staying was Haruki, wasn't it!?"
"…Correct. It wasn't hard to figure out, you know."

"In other words, the both of you had a blast laughing about me, didn't you!? About how ridiculous it was for a girl to agonize over a past she can't let go of, and how she's been acting like some stalker!"
"…If anything, I feel that Haruki-kun fits both of those descriptions better, though."
"See, you can't even respond to me! So it is true, isn't it!?"
"…Anyway, let's talk about what I came here to discuss. We won't get anywhere beating around the bush with this topic like that."
"…! What do you mean when you say we won't be going anywhere? Setsuna, you really are here to make a fool out of me…"
"Currently, our company is responsible for the production of the bonus CD 'Touma Kazusa Mini-Album' in Kaiousha's Ensemble's special issue."
"…Excuse me?"
"So today I've come to introduce myself and to confirm our schedule. Let's go over the track list in detail. After all, since you have a concert at the same time, our schedule is pretty tight."
"Kaiousha…? Ensemble…?"

"By the way, we will cover the entire cost this time, because to be truthful, our intention with this whole thing is to earn a favor with you for when your own CD is released here in Japan eventually."
"Your terms for this contract are really strict, Kazusa. I bet all the record labels that specialize in classical music are after a contract with you."
"He sold me out, didn't he…?"
"Hmm?"
"He sold me out, didn't he…?"
"What do you mean, 'sold you out'…?"
"For the sake of his own work… and to curry your favor, Setsuna… he sold me out, didn't he!?"
"…You think so?"
"A-After all… after all, if that wasn't the case, then this wouldn't be happening…!"
"…If that's what you believe, then you can go ahead and believe that… If you truly do believe your own words, that is."
"Still, it was Touma Youko-san… the president of the company you're affiliated with who decided this in the first place. So this is an official contract."
"Even… mom? You're telling me that even my mother's abandoned me…?"
"Why don't you ask her that yourself? …Youko-san was really worried about you, you know."
"Setsuna…?"
"She had her doubts, of course. It was Haruki-kun who managed to persuade Youko-san and make her give this job over to us."
"It'll be an impossible undertaking involving three friends… and three companies, Kaiousha, Knights Records, and Touma Youko Office."
"Friends…"
"We sent out the proposal on Monday, and we got our go-ahead this morning. Even for a mere Mini-Album coming with a magazine, this really is something rare."
"What's… that all about?"
"I'm saying that when you're involved, common corporate logic goes out the window… That's the power you, Touma Kazusa, possess."
"I don't care about that… I don't want power like that…"
"You'd be happy by simply having the person you love look at you? …You'd be happy as long as Haruki-kun reciprocated your feelings?"
"…Setsuna!"
"Kazusa… you truly do love Haruki-kun, don't you?"
"Fufu… Did I guess right? …Not that I'd ever have to guess."
"…Something wrong with that?"
"…Oh, just stop it now. It's not fair that you're acting so adorably."
"Stop teasing me…"
"No wonder Haruki-kun felt lost at the sight of that expression. No wonder he'd never want to let go of you again, Kazusa…"
"…Go home."
"I assume you understand the gist of the scope of our work, then?"
"That's enough, just go home already! I'm not taking a job like this. It's impossible!"
"…I understand, I'll head home for the time being. I actually only wanted to introduce myself today anyway."
"Don't… ever come back here again."
"Now, that won't do. The clock is ticking, after all, and we need to finish getting everything recorded before your additional concert."
"That's… that's just physically impossible. There are only two weeks left."
"Two weeks left… I do remember something like that happening in the past."
"Well then, good night. Ah, I'll leave this here. You can help yourself to it if you're hungry."
"I don't want it. Just take it and leave."
"I really didn't add anything weird in there, you know? Though I guess I can't guarantee that it'll taste good considering I made it myself…"
"Do whatever you want, just hurry and disappear already…"
"I understand… well then, good night. …See you tomorrow."
"I told you not to come back again!"
"…! Uu, uu… uu…!"
"Fuuuh…"
"Seems I'm up to a rough start."
"Is this really going to be okay? Am I really the right person for this?"
"…What am I saying? I can't sound resigned just after one day."
"Don't give up, me!"
"Io and the others must be really mad at me, huh?"
"What an idiot…"
"Isn't it supposed to be her birthday?"
"Why would she come all the way here on such an important day…?"
